title: Add health and resource telemetry
description: Add bounded, low-overhead health/resource signals needed to verify low-resource operation without exposing secrets or creating high-cost polling.
acceptanceCriteria: Health/metrics include service/database status, process/runtime counts, uptime, and resource fields that are safe to expose
Resource collection is bounded and does not add an unbounded per-request scan or tight timer
Metrics distinguish cache age, tunnel state, retry state, and error categories without credentials
A failing dependency is represented accurately and does not crash the endpoint
Tests cover healthy, degraded, and failed database/engine states

steps.description: Test response shape, redaction, bounded fields, and degraded database/engine behavior before production changes.

steps.details: Read `/api/health`, `/api/metrics`, engine stats, sampler, and instrumentation; map current data sources and polling behavior.
Add only the low-cost fields needed for release evidence, reusing existing caches and timers; preserve public health compatibility.
Run focused tests, custom harness, typecheck, lint, and a local endpoint smoke check with placeholder env.

technicalNotes: Do not expose raw process command lines or environment values through metrics.
